summary: Hubbell Incorporated filed an 8-K announcing completion of its acquisition of NSI Electrical Buyer, Inc. (NSI Industries) for $3.0 billion in cash. The purchase was funded via a $900 million unsecured term loan, $1.9 billion in senior notes, and commercial paper. The target provides electrical fittings and wire management products for industrial, infrastructure, and commercial markets. All issued and outstanding shares were acquired from seller NSI Buyer, LP. Terms include customary cash, debt, working capital, and expense adjustments. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee stated. The deal closed on June 9, 2026, with no further regulatory hurdles; watch integration progress and debt servicing.
